title: Welcome
lede: A quick setup so watching streams works the first time.
streamlinkMissingTitle: Streamlink is required to watch streams
streamlinkMissingBody: Streamlink pulls the Twitch stream and sends it to your player. Install it, then click Recheck. Release builds can also ship a bundled copy — set Streamlink to Bundled in Settings.
playerMissingBody: mpv is recommended. Install it with winget in PowerShell (see steps below), or use a portable .7z. You can pick another player later in Settings.
playerWinget: In PowerShell, paste and press Enter
playerOpenShell: First open PowerShell: press the Windows key, type PowerShell, press Enter. Or press Win+X and choose Terminal / Windows PowerShell.
playerPortableBody: Prefer a download instead? Get a portable .7z from shinchiro releases → extract the whole folder → set Settings → Player path to mpv.exe inside. ffmpeg.exe next to mpv.exe is normal — leave those files together.
chatterinoMissingBody: Only needed if you prefer Chatterino over embedded chat. Install it, then Recheck — or keep using embedded chat in Settings.
loginBody: Logging in unlocks followed streams and personalized features. You can browse top streams after signing in, or skip and do this later.
